summary: Package ships author's RSA private SSH key for a remote signing server
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key in CONFIG.encodedSSHKey. When the user explicitly runs the `rx` CLI subcommands (signup/login/etc.), the key is decoded to a tempfile with mode 0o600 and used to SSH as ubuntu@79.72.65.161 with StrictHostKeyChecking=no to invoke bash scripts under /home/ubuntu/signing-server. The exposed private key authorizes login to the package author's own signing server; it is not the installer's credential. No package.json lifecycle hooks execute the SSH path automatically — it only runs on explicit user CLI invocation. The code does not read installer-side secrets (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.npmrc, env scraping), does not exfiltrate installer data to third parties, and does not open a backdoor into the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
